operation: Read only the immutable original160 compute log once in Actions; recover necessary owner and four-component outcomes without scientific recomputation.

original_report.original_scope: Child70 and summary=null/componentflags=null alone do not determine the original scientific outcome.

necessary_scope.owner: All original initial/direction/lifted/closed/final/replay records; every original trial alpha/baseNorm/evaluation/norm/accept/reason/error and exact original unvisited direction/trial lists; original per-trial root-statistic values.
necessary_scope.component_records: Use the original direct precleanup start/return/all-component projections as the primary body. Retain all four states, original error/resource/flags/statistics/maxima and all unfinished stage/step/query/column suffixes. Optional old typed metadata supplements only fields missing from the direct projection; no full old tree is reconstructed or required.
necessary_scope.repeated_suffix_metadata: All actual trial rows remain. Exactly equal complete evaluation objects share one original-value table entry; equal unfinished/failed-stage nonaddress fields share values while every original address remains explicit. Different original key sets remain separate, not padded to infer missing values.
necessary_scope.large_successful_arrays: Only original full identities and original counts are returned. Binary128 state/J/sensitivity/factor payloads are neither downloaded nor numerically reaudited.
necessary_scope.original_errors: Original error fields up to6000bytes are complete; larger fields retain identity and first4/last4 matching lines (fallback first3/last3), limited to6000bytes. Independent diagnostic matcher keeps first6/last6 unique whole matching lines, each<=12000bytes within16000bytes total. Match counts are not error counts and can include false budget-exhaustion flags. All omitted text scope is explicit.
necessary_scope.printed_norms: Original number strings/hex words are copied. No residual, norm, interval, root, domain or derivative is recalculated.
necessary_scope.missing_original_fields: Explicitly unreported or partial; never recreated and never used to classify mathematical failure.
necessary_scope.owner_table_presence: The actual original trial and evaluation key sets are each deduplicated into their own table; every trial/evaluation row has its corresponding key-set index. An absent key and an explicitly null value remain distinct despite shared union columns. No new original field is inferred.

readback_complete_scope: The available original log reached EOF and the direct necessary protocol/source/owner-trial checks passed. Optional typed metadata or diagnostic stream incompleteness is reported separately and is not a full-tree or scientific gate. Reader success does not assert that original science, old transport, optional supplements, or large-array audits completed.
